title: Catalog product record
description: One record per product, stored at catalog/projects/<product_slug>.json. Structure only: the conditional rules that decide what may be listed live in the validator, which ships with this schema. Passing this schema is not a listing decision.

summary.description: One or two factual sentences about what the product does. Not an assessment, not review prose.

license.description: The upstream license as an SPDX identifier where one applies, or 'unknown' when it could not be established. 'unknown' blocks a listing.

self_hosting_permitted.description: Whether the upstream license permits self-hosting. false blocks a listing.

review.description: A reference to the published JuryPress review. Scores, Verdicts and review text are deliberately absent: they stay in the review and are joined at display time. Whether the review is still published is checked by the consumer at build time, not asserted here.

use_cases.description: The jobs a reader is trying to do. The first entry is the one the generated index files this product under.

provider.description: The hosting provider the recommended route targets, e.g. railway. The reader pays this provider directly; this repository hosts nothing.

route_url.description: The deployment route a reader follows. Required unless the listing state is retired, where it must be absent.

route_provenance.description: How the route was established as official or trusted, and why alternatives were not used.

maintained_path.description: Directory under deployments/ holding configuration maintained by this repository. Required for template_type maintained_here, and refused otherwise.

guide_path.description: The setup guide a reader follows, under deployments/<product_slug>/.

supplied_by.description: reader: the reader brings or pays for it. provider: the hosting provider offers it as part of the route. bundled: it ships with the product's own deployment.

constraints.description: Operating constraints a reader takes on: resource floors, manual steps, things that must be supplied. A constraint is not a gap in verification; untested areas belong in the verification block.

approval.description: A person's decision to publish this record. Present only once work_state is verified.

approved_config_digest.description: The deployment configuration digest that was approved. The validator recomputes it; a mismatch means the configuration changed after approval and re-verification plus re-approval are required.

verification.description: What a person actually ran, on what version, and what came of it. Present only once work_state is verified; absent otherwise, so that nothing in preparation can carry a verification claim.

verifier.description: The person who performed the deployment. An automated job is never a verifier.

target.description: The exact thing that was deployed. At least one of upstream_commit or image_digest is required; a tag alone does not pin anything.

template_revision.description: The template version or revision deployed, where the route is a provider template.

reason.description: Required for not_applicable, and expected for failed. Never a restatement of the result.

observed.description: What the verifier actually saw. Optional, and never a substitute for the result.

not_tested.description: Areas outside the defined checks that were not exercised. A non-empty list means the listing is at best experimental.

config_digest.description: Digest of the deployment configuration this verification covers. Recomputed by the validator; a mismatch means the record describes a different deployment from the one that was verified.

notes_paths.description: Optional long-form notes under notes/<product_slug>/. Nothing depends on a note, and a note never carries a check result.
